# Knowledge

Lasting, tested facts about this project, grouped by kind. Open a folder index to drill in.

## Folders

- [architecture/](architecture/INDEX.md) — **Architecture**: How the system is built: main parts, data flow, key design choices, and where code lives.
- [decisions/](decisions/INDEX.md) — **Decisions**: Decisions grouped by area of the system (one file per area). Each entry is dated: what was chosen, over what, and why. Never rewritten, only superseded.
- [gotchas/](gotchas/INDEX.md) — **Gotchas**: Traps, bugs and errors grouped by area of the system (one file per area), with symptom, cause and fix. Read the area's file before changing that area.
- [models/](models/INDEX.md) — **Models**: Data models, schemas, entities, and APIs between parts. Field meanings and invariants.
